Downloads may stop when the screen is off
Google phones pause background work to save battery, so a film can stop halfway with nothing to say why. Allowing this app to keep running lets a download finish while the phone is in your pocket.

Download over Wi-Fi only
Downloads wait for Wi-Fi instead of using mobile data. Off by default, because most people here have no Wi-Fi to wait for.
